U5C defines standardized methods, data structures, and communication patterns.
By providing a range of SDKs, and offering thorough documentation, U5C enhances reusability, interoperability, and performance in blockchain integrations.
Currently in its early stages, UTxO RPC is already being adopted by key projects in the Cardano ecosystem, including Lace, Mesh, Amaru, and many others.
This proposal aims to solve the following problem: UTxO RPC simplifies interactions with UTxO-based blockchains by providing a standardized interface for blockchain integrations.
It enhances interoperability, reusability, and performance for developers, and has already seen adoption by major Cardano projects like Lace, Mesh, and Amaru.
To fully unlock its potential for the Cardano community, UTxO RPC requires ongoing maintenance and enhancements.
This proposal seeks funding to keep it active, up-to-date, and aligned with the evolving needs of the ecosystem.
